pages.title: Fungi
pages.text: The surface is filled with different schools of $(item)Fungi$(), and they're all filled to the brim with magical energy.$(br2)The spores, cellular walls and root system all carries an enormous amount of magical energy.$(br2)All fungi components can be broken down in a $(item)Pulverizer$().

pages.title: Fungi
pages.text: $(item)Mushroom Caps$() is the most sustainable of these, and can be grown in $(item)Phytogenic Insolators$() under the right conditions.

pages.title: Nightstone
pages.text: $(item)The Midnight$() contain an abudance of $(item)Nightstone$().$(br2)Nightstone is used in some multiblocks, and can be purified into $(item)Living Rock$()

pages.title: Plantlife
pages.text: Ghost plants can be found in most biomes, and can be transmuted into $(item)Mystical White Flowers$() with a $(item)Resonating Wand$().$(br2)Furthermore the petals of the magical flower can be broken down into $(item)Floral Fertilizer$().

pages.title: Archaic Shards
pages.text: In most biomes you will find clusters of $(item)Trenchstone$(). Not all clusters will contain $(item)Archaic Shard$() ore, but most will.

This scorching hot magmatic rock can be found in $(item)Miasma Craters$(). Sadly we can't pinpoint it as its own biome, so your $(item)Natures Compass$() wont work.$(br2)However, these craters are huge. So you should be able to find them.
